author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Games Workshop has been hard at work creating an on-ramp for it's classic game of Fantasy Battles. The Old World Core Set has everything two players need to take their first steps into rank-and-flank combat with two armies, the complete rulebook, preconstructed armies and a variety of ways to play. Let's check it out!

Thanks to Games Workshop for the complimentary box to review.

author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Battle March is the new 400-750pt scale game of Fantasy Battles. Throw down a 30x44" table, grab some dice and one of the Regiment boxes of your choice and get in a bunch of Warhammer in a day. Let's check it out!

Thanks to Games Workshop for the complimentary book to review.
